ns2:course.label: Critical Issues in Higher Education
ns2:course.description: The examination of critical trends that impact higher education from various perspectives, including legal, organizational, and political. Same as EOL 580. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours.
